{{Quote|We are the Emperor's Guard. We protect him. Kill for him. Die for him.|Lassicar|<ref name="The Imperial Guard">{{TORcite|type=class|Jedi Knight|The Imperial Guard|Hoth}}</ref>}}
The '''Imperial Guard''', also known as the '''Emperor's Guard''', the '''Sith Honour Guard''' and the '''Dark Honor Guard''', was a force of elite [[Soldier/Legends|warriors]] who served the [[Tenebrae|Sith Emperor]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] as his personal [[Bodyguard/Legends|protectors and enforcers]]. Founded sometime before [[3959 BBY]], the Guard was composed entirely of non-[[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] individuals [[Telepathy/Legends|mentally bonded]] to the [[Emperor/Legends|Emperor]]. As a result, each Guardsman was fanatically loyal to their master and willing to [[Death/Legends|lay down their lives]] in the [[Sith Emperor's power base|service]] of the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] ruler, and even the members of the Empire's ruling [[Dark Council]] feared the Guard's prowess in combat. The warriors of the Imperial Guard were trained to use a wide variety of weapons and combat styles, making them more than a match for a single [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] or Sith. The Guard carried out the Emperor's will on battlefields across [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] during the [[Great Galactic War]], [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]], and [[Galactic War]] with the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. Even with the knowledge that the Emperor sought to [[Sith Emperor's ritual|consume all life in the galaxy]], the Guard remained loyal to their master, though they were unable to prevent the [[Order of Revan]] from invading the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[Yavin 4/Legends|Yavin 4]] and disturbing the Emperor's slumber there. The Guard was reorganized at some point following Vitiate's absence from the Imperial throne, later including more Force-sensitive members.

==Organization and philosophy==
{{Quote|Those who challenge the Imperial Guard challenge the Emperor himself.|Commander Tainor|<ref name="Down in History" />}}
An elite group of [[Soldier/Legends|soldiers]] chosen from among the ranks of the [[Imperial Military (Sith Empire)|Imperial Military]],<ref name="General Hesker">{{TORcite|type=codex|General Hesker}}</ref> the Imperial Guard was generally composed of members who lacked any degree of [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitivity]],<ref name="Codex" /> though their candidates were chosen from among the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire's]] greatest non-Force-sensitive warriors. On rare occasions, Force-sensitives would be inducted into the organization, such as Guardsman [[Xarovit Tovar]].<ref name="Academy">{{TORcite|exp=shadow|type=codex|Imperial Guard Academy}}</ref> Guardsmen were brought before the [[Tenebrae|Sith Emperor]] and [[Telepathy/Legends|mentally linked]] to the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] ruler. As a result, they were fanatically loyal to the [[Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] and incapable of ever betraying him,<ref name="Revan" /> becoming a vital part of [[Sith Emperor's power base|his power base]].<ref name="Encyclopedia" /> The Guardsmen were perfectly willing to [[Death/Legends|die]] for the Emperor, and carried out his every command without question. They were the protectors of the [[Sith Sanctum]]&mdash;the headquarters of the [[Sith Order (Sith Empire)|Sith Order]]&mdash;and the rest of the [[Imperial Citadel (Sith Empire)|Imperial Citadel]] on the Empire's [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Dromund Kaas/Legends|Dromund Kaas]], as well as the [[Sith Academy (Korriban)|Sith Academy]] on the world [[Korriban/Legends|Korriban]], though they were also deployed wherever the Emperor required. The Empire's ruling [[Dark Council]] had no authority over or insight into the Guard's activities.<ref name="Codex" />

==Equipment and training==
{{Quote|I am a member of the Emperor's personal guard&mdash;as are the men under my command. The soldiers you face are specially trained to kill Jedi&mdash;and they outnumber you.|Guardsman Lassicar|<ref name="Sub-Zero Showdown">{{TORcite|type=class|Jedi Knight|Sub-Zero Showdown|Hoth}}</ref>}}
[[File:Imperial_Guard_in_battle.png|thumb|left|170px|An Imperial Guard in battle]]
Members of the Imperial Guard were clad in [[Armor/Legends|armored]] [[Robe/Legends|robes]] of [[Color/Legends|red]] and crested helmets, while they wielded a variety of different weapons as the situation required.<ref name="Codex" /> Imperial Guardsmen would also don variations on the standard [[Imperial soldier]]'s armor when harsh environments required it, though their stark white armor and red markings distinguished those Guardsmen from normal [[Infantry/Legends|infantry]].<ref name="Sub-Zero Showdown" /> The primary weapon of a Guardsman was an [[Electrostaff/Legends|electrostaff]],<ref name="Revan" /> though the Guardsmen were proficient enough with [[Blaster rifle/Legends|blaster rifles]] and other weaponry to be considered deadly opponents regardless of their weapon.<ref name="Sub-Zero Showdown" /> The signal range 47.2 was used exclusively by members of the Imperial Guard, though their transmissions were largely encrypted.<ref name="The Devoted Ones" />

[[File:Imperial_Guard_with_a_Lightsaber.png|thumb|Imperial Guard with a [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]]|280x280px]]
The [[Sith Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] himself selected the locations of the Guard's academies, choosing worlds strong with the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side of the Force]] so that he could exert his influence and form bonds with his future Guardsmen. Candidates underwent a merciless training regimen designed by elder Guardsmen, and their training included regularly-scheduled battles to the death among the initiates. Each Guardsman underwent an indoctrination process where they were brought before the Emperor and were made to submit to his will;<ref name="Academy" /> a candidate named [[Iven]] resisted the process longer than any other in history, but when he finally broke, his mind also broke with him.<ref name="Iven">{{TORcite|exp=shadow|type=codex|Commandant Iven}}</ref> If a candidate survived the ordeal, they emerged a incredibly-skilled killing machine bound to the Emperor's will.<ref name="Academy" /> Guardsmen served for life; when a Guardsman reached the age where he or she was no longer suitable for active duty, they were appointed<ref name="Codex" /> as [[training commandant]]s<ref name="Iven" /> for the next generation of Guardsmen, and the new recruits would eventually kill the teachers whose skills deteriorated in their old age.<ref name="Codex" /> As an instructor at the [[Imperial Guard Academy]] on the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[Yavin 4/Legends|Yavin 4]], Commandant Iven had a candidate kill rate of over 80%.<ref name="Iven" />

The Guard also received intense training in [[Unarmed combat/Legends|martial arts]], so that they were more than a match for both [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] and Sith.<ref name="Codex" /> Guardsman [[Lassicar]] personally executed six different Jedi and over two dozen [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lords]] throughout his career, as well as a highly trained team of [[Agent/Legends|agents]] from the [[Republic Strategic Information Service|Strategic Information Service]]&mdash;the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic's]] covert intelligence agency.<ref name="Lassicar">{{TORcite|type=codex|Guardsman Lassicar (Knight)}}</ref> The reputation of the Guard was such that even the members of the Dark Council feared them, and throughout the Empire's history many Sith surrendered to the Guard rather than fight them when the Emperor's enforcers came to deliver their master's will.<ref name="Encyclopedia" /> While the Guardsmen were not Force-sensitive, they could draw upon the Emperor's power to strengthen themselves if they were close enough to their master.<ref name="Revan" />

==History==
===Protecting the Empire===
{{Quote|What about Nyriss? What will the Emperor do to her?''"<br />"''She will be purged by the Imperial Guard. Along with her entire staff of followers.|Scourge and Yarri|<ref name="Revan" />}}
The Imperial Guard, also known as the Emperor's Guard or the Dark Honor Guard, were first created by the Sith Emperor sometime after the founding of the reconstituted Sith Empire in [[4980 BBY]],<ref name="Encyclopedia" /> and by the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[3959 BBY]] the Guard were a common and feared sight on the Imperial capital of Dromund Kaas. Upon discovering the existence of the Empire, the [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knights]] [[Revan/Legends|Revan]] and [[Darth Malak|Malak]] attempted to infiltrate the Imperial Citadel and eliminate the Emperor, but the pair were unaware that the Guardsman whom they had convinced to help them was actually leading them into a trap. The Guardsman, a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Sith (species)/Legends|Sith pureblood]] named [[Yarri]], had already informed the Emperor of the forthcoming attack, and the Emperor easily defeated and corrupted the two Jedi when they confronted him, though Revan would later be redeemed by the [[Jedi Council/Legends|Jedi Council]].<ref name="Revan" />

In [[3950 BBY]], the Sith [[Lord/Legends|Lord]] [[Scourge (Sith)|Scourge]] alerted the Emperor to the existence of a [[Nathema conspiracy|conspiracy]] against him among the members of the Dark Council. As a result, the Emperor summoned the seven innocent members and two of the guilty Councilors to his chambers and killed them, while simultaneously dispatching the Imperial Guard to destroy the remaining three traitors and their power bases. The [[Purge of the Dark Council|purge]] was utterly effective, as the highly trained Imperial Guard overran the defenses of the Councilors' estates and massacred everyone within&mdash;including [[Darth Nyriss]] and her two co-conspirators. Not long afterward, however, the Guard failed to stop Scourge, Revan, and Revan's allies [[Meetra Surik]] and [[T3-M4]] from penetrating the heart of the Citadel, as the Sith Lord and the two powerful [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Masters]] caught the Guardsmen by surprise and battled their way into the Emperor's chambers. While the group's [[Attack on the Sith Emperor|attack]] ultimately failed,<ref name="Revan" /> it convinced the Emperor that he needed to take further precautions against death; he began to [[Essence transfer|transfer]] his consciousness between host bodies, with the current host known as the [[Emperor's Voice (Sith Empire)|Emperor's Voice]].<ref name="Encyclopedia" />

[[File:Sith_army_invasion.jpg|thumb|right|280px|An Imperial Guard on Bothawui]]
After the spirit of the Sith Lord [[Naga Sadow/Legends|Naga Sadow]] was eliminated from Yavin 4 by the Emperor's agents around [[3756 BBY]],<ref name="Timeline">{{TORweb|url=holonet/galactic-history|text=Timeline 7: Peace for the Republic?|int=Timeline 7: Peace for the Republic?}}</ref> the Emperor took control of the moon, and the Guard established an academy there. The academy also served to protect the [[Temple of Sacrifice]], a Sith structure that contained the Emperor's failsafe in case his Voice was slain.<ref name="The Devoted Ones" /> During the [[Great Galactic War]] with the Galactic Republic, the Imperial Guard continued to serve as protectors of the Imperial Citadel,<ref name="Blood of the Empire 1">''[[The Old Republic, Blood of the Empire Act 1: Shades of the Sith]]''</ref> and after the [[Battle of Korriban|reclamation]] of Korriban from the Republic in [[3681 BBY]], the Guard became the Sith Academy's defenders as well. However, the Imperial Guard also oversaw the machinery and equipment in the depths of the Academy that the Emperor used to create his [[Children of the Emperor|Children]]&mdash;individuals who were unknowing extensions of the Emperor's will&mdash; and the Guardsmen ensured that their master's plans were not interfered with.<ref name="Blood of the Empire 3">''[[The Old Republic, Blood of the Empire Act 3: Burn the Future]]''</ref>

Those Guardsmen who protected the Academy and the [[Dark Council Chambers|Dark Council's chambers]] there were known as the Dark Honor Guard, with Guardsmen such as the [[Cyborg/Legends|cyborg]] [[Naman Fal]] stationed there in the years after the Great War's end in [[3653 BBY]].<ref name="Grave Robbers">{{TORcite|type=general|Grave Robbers|Korriban}}</ref> Several Imperial Guardsmen also participated in the [[Battle of Bothawui (Second; Great Galactic War)|second Battle of Bothawui]] in [[3671 BBY]], where they fought alongside the Imperial Military under [[Grand Moff/Legends|Grand Moff]] [[Zellos]] in an effort to destroy the [[Deflector shield generator/Legends|deflector shield generator]] guarded by Jedi Master [[Belth Allusis]] and his small force of Republic defenders.<ref name="Timeline 5">{{TORweb|url=holonet/galactic-history|text=Timeline 5: The Battle of Bothawui|int=Timeline 5: The Battle of Bothawui}}</ref>

===Waging war===
{{Quote|It's extremely rare to see more than one at a time. As a unit, they've never been defeated and answer directly to the Emperor.|General [[Aves (general)|Aves]]|<ref name="Green Battleground">{{TORcite|type=faction|Republic|Green Battleground|Corellia}}</ref>}}
During the subsequent [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]], the Guard continued to protect the Emperor and enforce his will, though as conflict began to break out again, members of the Guard were deployed across [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] to enact the Emperor's commands.<ref name="Sub-Zero Showdown" /> During the galactic conflict, a number of Guardsmen were also [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lords]]; [[Xoc'dal]], [[Xheoch Den]], [[Djanistak]], [[Chanigresh]], [[Feldrax Kar]], [[Toreshi Xach]], [[Sendesh Xaq]], and [[Doshcra Vael]] all wielded two [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsabers]] in combat and served as high-ranking commanders of Imperial forces throughout the galaxy.<ref name="Strongholds">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Galactic Strongholds]]''</ref> Several Guardsmen under the leadership of Lassicar were sent to the [[Water/Legends|icy]] planet of [[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]]<ref name="Sub-Zero Showdown" /> around [[3642 BBY]]<ref name="Time">{{TOR dates|2}}</ref> in order to stop the Jedi Knight known as the [[Hero of Tython]] from recovering the plans for the [[Emperor's Fortress]], though their initial efforts were foiled by the Knight and the [[Republic trooper|soldiers]] of the Republic's [[301st Infantry]].<ref name="Sub-Zero Showdown" /> The mission would end in failure when Lassicar and the remaining Guardsmen were killed in battle with the Knight in the ruins of the ''[[Star of Coruscant]]'' dreadnaught.<ref name="The Imperial Guard" />

[[File:Imperial_Guard_Master.png|thumb|left|200px|An Imperial Guard battles T7-O1 and the Hero of Tython.]]
When the Knight [[Mission to the Emperor's Fortress|boarded]] the Emperor's [[Space station/Legends|space station]] along with the rest of a [[Jedi strike team (capture of the Sith Emperor)|Jedi strike team]] led by Master [[Tol Braga]], [[Commander/Legends|Commander]] [[Trahg]] led his fellow Guardsmen and the [[Sithspawn/Legends|Sithspawn]] known as [[Harrower assassin]]s in a defense of the station. However, Trahg was killed along with many of his men by the Hero and the Jedi Knight [[Kira Carsen]], and despite the efforts of the Guard, all of the Jedi reached the throne room&mdash;where the Emperor dominated their minds and corrupted them into his servants<ref name="Descent" /> as he had done to Revan and Malak.<ref name="Revan" /> The Hero broke free from the Emperor's control, however, and the Jedi was able to escape the station because the Guardsmen still believed the Knight to be a servant of the Emperor.<ref name="An Unthinkable Alliance">{{TORcite|type=class|Jedi Knight|An Unthinkable Alliance|the Emperor's Fortress}}</ref> As the Emperor orchestrated an Imperial [[Invasion of Belsavis|assault]] on the Republic [[Prison/Legends|prison]] world of [[Belsavis/Legends|Belsavis]],<ref name="Anarchy">{{TORcite|type=class|Jedi Knight|Anarchy|Belsavis}}</ref> members of the Imperial Guard were sent on multiple missions to the planet. Commander [[Calum]] was ordered to retrieve the six Sith Lords known as the [[Dread Masters]] from their imprisonment,<ref name="The Dread Masters">{{TORcite|type=faction|Imperial|The Dread Masters|Belsavis}}</ref> and Commander [[Vorel]] led an attempt to recover technology of the ancient [[Rakata/Legends|Rakata]] [[Species/Legends|species]] that had once inhabited the world.<ref name="Belsavis Reborn">{{TORcite|type=faction|Imperial|Belsavis Reborn|Belsavis}}</ref>

The Imperial Guard also served in the [[Battle of Corellia]], with Commander [[Tainor]]&mdash;the head of the Imperial Guard&mdash;directing his Guardsmen<ref name="Down in History" /> in aiding the Imperial offensive in the [[Axial Park]] district.<ref name="Green Battleground" /> [[General/Legends|General]] [[Hesker]]'s forces aided [[Darth Decimus]] in the battle for Axial Park<ref name="The Fight for Axial Park">{{TORcite|type=faction|Imperial|The Fight for Axial Park|Corellia}}</ref> and the storming of the [[Green Jedi Enclave|Enclave]] of [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia's]] native [[Corellian Jedi|Green Jedi]],<ref name="The Battle of Corellia">{{TORcite|type=faction|Imperial|The Battle of Corellia|Corellia}}</ref> and Commander [[Jastal]]'s forces battled the [[Droid/Legends|droid]] [[Army/Legends|army]] of the [[Czerka Arms/Legends|Czerka Corporation]] in the [[Incorporation Islands]] district.<ref name="Engineering Breakdown">{{TORcite|type=faction|Imperial|Engineering Breakdown|Corellia}}</ref> Guardsmen [[Churnis]] and another Guardsmen were also assigned to [[Moff/Legends|Moff]] [[Alvon Zamar]] during his survey of Imperial resources on the Corellian battlefront,<ref name="The Sky Burns">{{TORcite|type=class|Imperial Agent|The Sky Burns|Corellia}}</ref> and several Guardsmen aided their Emperor's [[Syo Bakarn|First Son]] and the Children of the Emperor in securing the fortress known as the [[Guardian Hold Four]] on Corellia.<ref name="Old Blood">{{TORcite|type=class|Jedi Consular|Old Blood|Corellia}}</ref>

Dozens of Guardsmen accompanied the Emperor to the [[Dark Temple]] on the outskirts of Dromund Kaas's [[Kaas City]] when the Hero of Tython embarked on a [[Dromund Kaas operation|mission]] to confront the Sith ruler, and the warriors fought in vain to prevent the Jedi Knight from entering the Dark Temple. The Knight's companions engaged the Temple's defenders from multiple directions to draw them away from the Hero's path, though one of the attackers was pinned down in the access tunnels beneath the Temple until the Knight rescued them. Despite the Guard's efforts, the [[Emperor's Voice (Sith Empire)|Emperor's Voice]]&mdash;his host body and the vessel for his consciousness and power in [[The Force/Legends|the Force]]&mdash;was struck down in battle,<ref name="Doomsday">{{TORcite|type=class|Jedi Knight|Doomsday|Dromund Kaas}}</ref> and the Emperor's essence retreated to Yavin 4. The commander of the academy there, Commandant Iven, was tasked by the Emperor and agents of the [[Hand of the Empire|Emperor's Hand]] with the protection of the moon.<ref name="The Devoted Ones" />

===In the Emperor's absence===
{{Quote|Invaders! Interlopers! This world is off limits! He told us from the start. Only the devoted! Only the purest! His orders, his command!|A crazed Commandant Iven, after the Revanite invasion|<ref name="The Devoted Ones" />}}
The rogue Sith Lord [[Darth Malgus]] established his own [[New Imperial Guard]] when he declared his [[New Empire]] on [[Ilum/Legends|Ilum]] shortly after the Emperor's defeat, choosing the [[Chagrian/Legends|Chagrian]] [[Chondrus Berani]] to lead his protectors. Some members of the New Guard wielded [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsabers]] in [[Lightsaber combat/Legends|combat]], unlike the true Imperial Guard, and the New Guard's armor featured darker hues and black markings to distinguish themselves from their counterparts in the Sith Empire. That insult, as well as Malgus' audacity to seize the Emperor's throne, drove the Imperial Guard to help battle the New Empire's forces on Ilum.<ref name="FE" /> However, the Guard gradually withdrew from Imperial affairs, and though it soon become public knowledge among the Empire's upper echelons that the Emperor sought to [[Sith Emperor's ritual|eradicate all life in the galaxy]], the prospect of their death did not faze the Emperor's protectors.<ref name="The Devoted Ones" />

Later in the war, the mad Force-user Revan and his fanatical [[Order of Revan]] invaded Yavin 4, as Revan sought to restore the Emperor to physical form in order to kill him permanently. The Guardsmen under Commandant Iven were nearly eradicated by the Revanite forces; the academy was left in ruins, and what little remained of Iven's sanity began to crumble in the face of his failure to prevent the Revanites from intruding on his master's sacred ground. A coalition of Imperial and Republic forces, united in their desire to prevent Revan from resurrecting the Emperor, discovered the academy and captured Iven, whose interrogation revealed the existent of a [[Sith artifact/Legends|Sith artifact]] in the Temple of Sacrifice that could restore the Emperor's strength.<ref name="The Devoted Ones" />

By the year [[3630 BBY]],<ref name="KOTET Date">{{TOR_updates|5.0}}</ref> the Sith Empire maintained an "Imperial Honor Guard," which repurposed both the name and the armor of the former Emperor's Imperial Guardsmen in the service of the Sith Empire, although this guard was not linked to Vitiate as its predecessor was.<ref name="KOTET">{{TORcite|exp=kotet|chapter=2}}</ref> This reorganized guard included more Force-sensitive members such as [[Darth Ben'hade]].<ref name="Ambient1">{{TORcite|exp=kotet|type=location|Imperial Base|Iokath}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:Imperial_Guard_on_Korriban.png|thumb|right|140px|A "Dark Honor Guard" on Korriban]]
The Imperial Guard first appeared in the [[Star Wars comic books|webcomic]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic, Blood of the Empire]]'', though no information was given on them beyond their role as protectors of the Imperial Citadel.<ref name="Blood of the Empire 1" /><ref name="Blood of the Empire 3" /> [[Drew Karpyshyn]]'s [[2011]] novel ''[[The Old Republic: Revan]]'', which shed light on much of the Sith Empire's backstory and organization, named the Imperial Guard and gave additional history and information on the group.<ref name="Revan" /> The Guard appeared throughout [[BioWare]]'s and [[LucasArts]]' [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' as mission-givers,<ref name="Belsavis Reborn" /> sentry characters on Imperial worlds,<ref name="Grave Robbers" /> or enemies to Republic characters on high-level planets.<ref name="Sub-Zero Showdown" />

Some Imperial Guardsmen on Korriban are referred to as "Dark Honor Guard(s),"<ref name="Grave Robbers" /> though they are universally referred to as either the Imperial Guard or the Emperor's Guard throughout the rest of the game.<ref name="Codex" /><ref name="Sub-Zero Showdown" /> The Digital Expansion ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Galactic Strongholds]]'' added "Conquest Commanders" that are Imperial Guardsmen and also Sith Lords,<ref name="Strongholds" /> and the Digital Expansion ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Shadow of Revan]]'' expanded on the Guard's training and their presence on Yavin 4. ''Shadow of Revan'' also includes [[Xarovit Tovar]], a Conquest Commander for Yavin 4 who wears Guardsmen armor, despite the Imperial Guard having split with the Empire.<ref name="The Devoted Ones" />
